text: PRIORITY: Windows Search was crawling every git worktree under C:\Users\<user>\IdeaProjects (SearchIndexer 15-19 CPU-s per new worktree, 5 GB index). Pull fast-track, run scripts/operator/search_index
cmd: git -C <primary checkout> pull --ff-only origin fast-track; powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File <primary checkout>\scripts\operator\search_index_scope.ps1
